name: Tests

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  tests:
    name: Tests PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [7.4, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3]
        experimental: [false]
        include:
          - php: 8.2
            analysis: true

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          coverage: xdebug

      - name: Install dependencies with Composer
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpcs

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

      - name: Upload coverage results to Coveralls
        if: matrix.analysis
        env:
          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          composer require php-coveralls/php-coveralls -n -W
          vendor/bin/php-coveralls --coverage_clover=clover.xml -v

```

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpcs

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

      - name: Upload coverage results to Coveralls
        if: matrix.analysis
        env:
          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          composer require php-coveralls/php-coveralls -n -W
          vendor/bin/php-coveralls --coverage_clover=clover.xml -v

        with:

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpcs

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

        if: matrix.analysis

          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      matrix:

        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          coverage: xdebug

      - name: Install dependencies with Composer
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpcs

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

      - name: Upload coverage results to Coveralls
        if: matrix.analysis
        env:
          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          composer require php-coveralls/php-coveralls -n -W

jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}

      matrix:

      - name: Set up PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          coverage: xdebug

      - name: Install dependencies with Composer
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpcs

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

      - name: Upload coverage results to Coveralls
        if: matrix.analysis
        env:
          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          composer require php-coveralls/php-coveralls -n -W
          vendor/bin/php-coveralls --coverage_clover=clover.xml -v

name: Tests

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  tests:
    name: Tests PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [7.4, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3]
        experimental: [false]
        include:
          - php: 8.2
            analysis: true

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          coverage: xdebug

      - name: Install dependencies with Composer
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpcs

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

      - name: Upload coverage results to Coveralls
        if: matrix.analysis
        env:
          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          composer require php-coveralls/php-coveralls -n -W
          vendor/bin/php-coveralls --coverage_clover=clover.xml -v

name: Tests

jobs:

    name: Tests PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [7.4, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3]

        include:
          - php: 8.2

      - name: Set up PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          coverage: xdebug

      - name: Install dependencies with Composer
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpcs

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpcs

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

        if: matrix.analysis

        run: |
          composer require php-coveralls/php-coveralls -n -W
          vendor/bin/php-coveralls --coverage_clover=clover.xml -v

name: Tests

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  tests:
    name: Tests PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [7.4, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3]
        experimental: [false]
        include:
          - php: 8.2
            analysis: true

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          coverage: xdebug

      - name: Install dependencies with Composer
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpcs

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

      - name: Upload coverage results to Coveralls
        if: matrix.analysis
        env:
          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          composer require php-coveralls/php-coveralls -n -W
          vendor/bin/php-coveralls --coverage_clover=clover.xml -v

   ```dockerfile
   FROM php:7.4-cli-slim  # Adjust the base image based on the project's language and dependencies

   # Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
   ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
   RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

   # Install git first, separately from other packages
   RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git

   # Install other relevant packages, for example, curl, and composer
   RUN apt-get update && \
       apt-get install -y curl && \
       apt-get clean && \
       rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* || exit 0

   WORKDIR /app

   # Clone the Slim repository
   RUN git clone https://github.com/slimphp/Slim.git || exit 0

   WORKDIR /app/Slim

   # Install Composer globally
   RUN curl -sS https://getcomposer.org/installer | php -- --install-dir=/usr/local/bin --filename=composer

   # Install project dependencies
   RUN composer install

   CMD ["/bin/bash"]
   ```

   - Inside the container, use `composer test` to execute the test suite. This command assumes you have installed all the necessary development dependencies via Composer.

4. **Dependency Management**: Ensure that you:
   - Install required system packages (like git and curl) and language runtimes (PHP).
   - Install any language-specific dependencies as specified in the project’s documentation or configuration files.
   - Run any setup or migration scripts as needed.

5. **Important Notes**:
   - **Do not add '|| exit 0'** to commands you run directly on the Linux terminal. Only add it to RUN instructions within the Dockerfile.

        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:

          coverage: xdebug

      - name: Install dependencies with Composer
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpcs

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

        if: matrix.analysis

          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |

jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
    strategy:

      matrix:

        include:

      - name: Set up PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          coverage: xdebug

      - name: Install dependencies with Composer
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpcs

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

      - name: Upload coverage results to Coveralls
        if: matrix.analysis
        env:
          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          composer require php-coveralls/php-coveralls -n -W
          vendor/bin/php-coveralls --coverage_clover=clover.xml -v

        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:

      - name: Install dependencies with Composer

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpcs

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

        if: matrix.analysis

          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install dependencies with Composer
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpcs

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

        if: matrix.analysis

name: Tests

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:

    name: Tests PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [7.4, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3]
        experimental: [false]
        include:
          - php: 8.2
            analysis: true

    steps:

        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          coverage: xdebug

      - name: Install dependencies with Composer
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpcs

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

      - name: Upload coverage results to Coveralls
        if: matrix.analysis
        env:
          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          composer require php-coveralls/php-coveralls -n -W
          vendor/bin/php-coveralls --coverage_clover=clover.xml -v

   RUN apt-get update && \
       apt-get install -y curl && \

   WORKDIR /app

   WORKDIR /app/Slim

   # Install Composer globally

   # Install project dependencies

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:

        include:
          - php: 8.2

        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          coverage: xdebug

      - name: Install dependencies with Composer
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpcs

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

      - name: Upload coverage results to Coveralls
        if: matrix.analysis
        env:
          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          composer require php-coveralls/php-coveralls -n -W
          vendor/bin/php-coveralls --coverage_clover=clover.xml -v

        with:

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

        if: matrix.analysis

          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

        if: matrix.analysis

        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests

          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

        if: matrix.analysis

name: Tests

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  tests:
    name: Tests PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [7.4, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3]
        experimental: [false]
        include:
          - php: 8.2
            analysis: true

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          coverage: xdebug

      - name: Install dependencies with Composer
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpcs

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

      - name: Upload coverage results to Coveralls
        if: matrix.analysis
        env:
          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          composer require php-coveralls/php-coveralls -n -W
          vendor/bin/php-coveralls --coverage_clover=clover.xml -v

        if: matrix.analysis

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

name: Tests

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  tests:
    name: Tests PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [7.4, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3]
        experimental: [false]
        include:
          - php: 8.2
            analysis: true

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          coverage: xdebug

      - name: Install dependencies with Composer
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpcs

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

      - name: Upload coverage results to Coveralls
        if: matrix.analysis
        env:
          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          composer require php-coveralls/php-coveralls -n -W
          vendor/bin/php-coveralls --coverage_clover=clover.xml -v

        with:

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

        if: matrix.analysis

          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

name: Tests

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  tests:
    name: Tests PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [7.4, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3]
        experimental: [false]
        include:
          - php: 8.2
            analysis: true

      - name: Set up PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          coverage: xdebug

      - name: Install dependencies with Composer
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpcs

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

      - name: Upload coverage results to Coveralls
        if: matrix.analysis
        env:
          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          composer require php-coveralls/php-coveralls -n -W

   RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git

   RUN apt-get update && \
       apt-get install -y curl && \
       apt-get clean && \
       rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* || exit 0

   WORKDIR /app

   # Clone the Slim repository
   RUN git clone https://github.com/slimphp/Slim.git || exit 0

   WORKDIR /app/Slim

   # Install Composer globally
   RUN curl -sS https://getcomposer.org/installer | php -- --install-dir=/usr/local/bin --filename=composer

   # Install project dependencies
   RUN composer install

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests

name: Tests

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  tests:
    name: Tests PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [7.4, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3]
        experimental: [false]
        include:
          - php: 8.2
            analysis: true

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          coverage: xdebug

      - name: Install dependencies with Composer
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3

      - name: Coding standards
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpcs

      - name: Static analysis
        if: matrix.analysis
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan

      - name: Tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover clover.xml

      - name: Upload coverage results to Coveralls
        if: matrix.analysis
        env:
          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          composer require php-coveralls/php-coveralls -n -W
          vendor/bin/php-coveralls --coverage_clover=clover.xml -v

        if: matrix.analysis
